title: Chunk 7.6 — MCP Usage, Security & Cost Controls

questions.description: MCP uses stdio transport, not HTTP. Options: env var API key, MCP config token, or both.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Environment variable PAPERVIZ_API_KEY — simplest for stdio MCP, matches existing GEMINI_API_KEY pattern

questions.prompt: What rate limits for MCP operations?
questions.description: Per API key. analyze_paper is expensive (Gemini calls), read operations are cheap.
Agents paste paper text. Too large wastes Gemini tokens, too small limits usefulness.

questions.prompt: Max concurrent analyze_paper jobs per API key?
questions.description: Prevents one agent from monopolizing Gemini quota.
How long before an analyze_paper call times out? Papers can take 1-3 minutes.
questions.recommendedAnswer: 5 minutes (covers most papers with retry headroom)

questions.prompt: Should MCP reuse the existing free/pro/research tier system?
questions.description: Current tiers are fingerprint-based (IP+UA). MCP uses API keys.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — map API keys to tiers, reuse same limits. Pro agents get Pro limits.

questions.prompt: Track cost attribution per MCP operation?
questions.description: Log Gemini token usage per tool call for cost analysis.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — log operation, tokens used, estimated cost to analytics_events
